about_the_game:
Post-Apocalypse Revelation: Pan-Humanity

Years after the nuclear winter, rapid global warming has caused the oceans to swallow most of the land, sinking former cities into the abyss.

Yet the true horror lingers unseen: shattered fragments of human DNA drift through the air, invading organic life like a plague—twisting animals, plants, and even the earth itself. Giant trees pulse with human-like hearts; the seas writhe with flesh-fused tentacles—the planet is descending into a biological nightmare beyond control, and human civilization is undergoing a grotesque “rebirth.”

It seems the apocalypse wasn’t caused by nuclear war alone. Some speculate that genetic weapons were deployed to target officials hidden in bunkers.

No time to dwell on that now…

A Flicker of Last Hope

While exploring a abandoned human silo base, members of the "Burrow Clan" unexpectedly discovered a pure, uncontaminated four-leaf clover—an extremely rare lifeform untouched by genetic pollution after the apocalypse. Its pristine genetic sequence may hold the key to restarting Earth's ecosystem. But these ruins have long been occupied by "Aberrations" (fully humanized terrifying creatures) that greedily seek to claim any life that remains unassimilated...

You, Fix, Surveyor of the Burrow Clan

  • Utilize the environment to fight underground creatures, consume human DNA to enhance yourself, and assemble and upgrade weapons to battle the Aberrations.

  • Build base turrets to defend against the hive's attacks and protect the four-leaf clover from harm.

  • Take up excavators, chainsaws, or pile drivers to dig downward and collect mineral deposits.

Make Your Choice: Humanity or Instinct

You are both the infected and the savior; a beast, yet carrying the flame of human wisdom.

Walk the razor's edge between destruction and rebirth, madness and reason.
Protect this faint green shimmer of hope.

(Elder… sometimes I can't tell—am I a fox infected with human DNA, or a human trapped inside the body of a fox?)

name: Earth Parasite: Silo Demo
short_description: A post-apocalyptic mining, action tower defense, lightly roguelite, anti-human, hand-drawn sci-fi game. Wield excavators, pile drivers, or flamethrowers to battle humans. Consume human DNA to enhance your abilities—but ultimately lose your humanity in the process.
supported_languages:
English, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*, Portuguese - Brazil
*languages with full audio support
